mapper.select: SELECT id, name, definition, is_default AS isDefault, status, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM persona WHERE is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, definition, is_default AS isDefault, status, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM persona WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT id, name, definition, is_default AS isDefault, status, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM persona ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persona (name, definition, is_default, status, version_no) VALUES (#{name}, #{definition}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{versionNo})
